Definition: neuter of a compound of G5475 and G3030 (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy); burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre:--fine brass.
BiblicalUsage: Chalkolibanon is fine brass, brass refined in a furnace — and it appears twice, both times of Christ: His feet like fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace, and the Son of God whose feet are like fine brass.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe feet like fine brass are feet that have been through the fire and cannot be burned — and they are coming to walk among the churches.
RelatedEvents: John's Vision of the Risen Christ on Patmos; The Letter to the Church in Thyatira
